SON OF A GENERAL OVERSEER WHO IS IN THE TRAP OF THE DEVIL: HOW IT STARTED.

SON OF A GENERAL OVERSEER WHO IS IN THE TRAP OF THE DEVIL: HOW IT STARTED.
(By Latunde Akin)
A older sister in the church headquarters called him to ofiice and started enticing hin with money,care and gifts. He was in his teenage years then and his father and mother didn't have time for him due to their very busy schedule.
This church sister lured him into concentrated immorality without the knowledge of his parent.
He will sleep with this far older sister even in church premises.
The parents were busy preaching to others when they couldn't have time for their own children.
Even the General Overseer has no such time for his wife that his wife secretly complained a lot and had to endure the pain. Inturn the wife too took solace in getting herself busy that she left her children in the hand of carers. She didn't even have time to personally cook for her husband . They had cooks .
In a very sensitive spiritual environment as church they overlooked the sophisticated networks of hypocrites and proffesional devils. The never believed in DELIVERANCE. They taught bible so much till bible began smoking
I NEED DELIVERANCE .
What do I mean by bible smoking I NEED DELIVERANCE?
When people teach bible from cover to cover and yet they couldn't cover it enough. The bible then began to feel it's in bondage in their hands. And then began to shout
I NEED DELIVERANCE BIKO!
When you begin to tell people there's nothing like deliverance after salvation experience,then the devils in the church will become so happy to perpetrate evils in the life of those who become cold after being saved.
If there is possibility of coldness and backsliding then there is also possibility that believers in Christ can be afflicted at that time of coldness,prayerlessness. So the need for deliverance prayers. Hot prayers.
They may never become possessed but they can be depressed, obsessed and oppressed in certain aspects of life when they are cold.
This son eventually grew to be sleeping with church sisters and the rest. He became a stylish thief and took money to buy things.
When his parents eventually discovered their lapses,it was too late so they had to cover up their lapses so that the church won't scatter. They bundled the son far away into oblivion and the matter grew worse for the son than the beginning.
All those who knew this couldn't talk or face them to tell them reality of calming down to draw the son closer in love. Those who tried to know what was going on then were transferred into far bushes to go and pastor there. Some were disciplined because they tried to question somethings regarding the matter as related to not covering up. They will just find an offence not related to nab them and judge them. And to be sincerely, it's not easy building a church and seeing it scattered.
But the main issue is that the devil has covered the General Overseer through his son. He can't get the General Overseer but he got his son through the parent's lack of knowledge in Spiritual Warfare and DELIVERANCE. If anyone tries to tell the man's wife then about witchcraft operations,she may even become your enemy. For you to know how deep their bible was crying for deliverance. They think they knew bible but bible is saying YOU CAN'T KNOW ME ENOUGH!
Their son became another thing else in that far away oblivion. Duped a lot of people in millions. Blackmailed a lot with vedio sex so they can keep shut etc.
When the battle was thick for him,he tried to come back home to the Lord but the father's love became absent from his father. A prodigal son was left in the cold to keep suffering for his many sins. What a father's love? What a life?
The devil is feeling so happy
now that his father doesn't have time for his son's homecoming. The father is too busy preaching gospel all around the world.
For me, I strongly believe in INTERCESSION of the brethren. So that we can stop devils happiness over this matter.
You must not rejoice over this or try to blame anybody. What you and I must do now is to first learn from the situation and then cry for mercy on behalf of the parents and the son.
The prodigal son must be welcomed home and must not be left to suffer for his sins. Jesus didn't taech us that way !
I believe you should be genuinely ready now to intercede? You don't need any names to do that. God knows them and he will answer your prayers in Jesus name.
In our little corner,we had engaged interceeding for them for more than 300days and we are still doing.
We are not perfect too but God sees our hearts and probably that's why He is protecting us too despite many negative thoughts of people thinking otherwise.
Nobody can judge anyone better,not even me. But God is our greatest judge. He judges the intent of people's heart better.
So let us first learn from others mistakes and pray for them genuinely always.
God bless you all for reading through. Amen
